content.text: In regions where conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-every-detail-you-4|USDT Payment]] platforms like Stripe and PayPal are blocked, digital creators face significant hurdles in establishing online stores. This is particularly true for countries such as Nigeria and Venezuela, where financial restrictions stifle growth. COREMERCH offers a robust solution: a deployment process that leverages [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/github-pages-free-digital-product-store-hosting-explained-7|github]] Pages and Apps Script to create a fully functional store, allowing you to accept [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payments-tanzanian-online-sellers-step-step-deployment-4|COREMERCH guide to crypto]] payments without any reliance on traditional payment gateways.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The failure of conventional platforms to support creators in various regions underscores the necessity for a sovereign commerce infrastructure. With COREMERCH's model, you gain complete ownership of your store, bypassing the limitations imposed by traditional payment systems. This infrastructure is designed to withstand financial isolation, ensuring that you maintain control over your data and transactions. By employing tools like GitHub Pages and NOWPayments, you can create a resilient online store that operates seamlessly regardless of external financial pressures.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you start deploying your digital store, ensure you have the necessary components in place. You need a GitHub account to host your store on GitHub Pages, a Google account for Apps Script, and a NOWPayments account for crypto payment processing. Familiarize yourself with the Sovereign Blueprint, as it provides the roadmap for your deployment. Set up your product catalog, gather your digital files for delivery, and prepare to configure your payment methods. Proper preparation will streamline your deployment process.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by configuring your NOWPayments account to accept various cryptocurrencies. This setup is crucial as it allows you to process payments automatically with minimal fees. Next, link your NOWPayments to your GitHub Pages store using Apps Script. This integration will handle transaction notifications and ensure that your customers receive their digital products instantly upon payment confirmation. Use Google Drive for file storage, providing seamless access for your customers once their payments are verified.
Complete ownership of your store means no platform dependencies.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your store is set up, it’s time to go live. Ensure all configurations are tested in a controlled environment before you start promoting your store. When you’re ready, share your store link on social media and other platforms to attract customers. Monitor your first transactions closely, ensuring that payments are processed correctly and that customers receive their products without delay. This real-world testing will help identify any potential issues that may arise.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully deploying your store, consider scaling your operations. With the Edge Commerce Stack, you can expand your product offerings and enhance your store's capabilities. Integrate additional payment methods and optimize your delivery process for efficiency. Monitor your traffic and sales metrics to adjust your strategies accordingly. Leveraging Supabase can help manage increased customer data and orders, ensuring a smooth experience as your business grows.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, use GitHub Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for payment processing. This combination allows you to bypass the limitations of traditional payment platforms efficiently. With core tools in place, you can set up your store in just a few hours, managing everything independently.
Deploy your digital store in hours, not weeks.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're interested in expanding your infrastructure, consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for enhanced capabilities. This stack includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and a fully integrated Supabase backend, allowing for a more robust store setup. For more information, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Create a GitHub account to host your store on GitHub Pages. Set up a Google account for Apps Script to manage backend logic. Register for a NOWPayments account to handle crypto payments. Prepare your product files and descriptions for easy upload. Follow the Sovereign Blueprint for step-by-step deployment instructions. Test your setup thoroughly before going live. Promote your store link across multiple channels to attract customers.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, utilize GitHub Pages for hosting and integrate NOWPayments for payment processing. This method eliminates reliance on traditional payment platforms and provides complete ownership of your store.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 utilizes GitHub Pages and Apps Script, allowing you to deploy your store in 4-6 hours. Stack 02, known as the Edge Commerce Stack, is built on Cloudflare Pages and Workers, offering a more robust setup and deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages are excellent options for hosting a digital product store. They offer robust capabilities for deploying static sites and integrating with payment processors like NOWPayments.
Is there ongoing support after deployment?
Yes, COREMERCH provides 30-day support following the deployment of your stack. This support ensures that you can resolve any issues that arise as you begin to operate your store.
How secure is using NOWPayments for transactions?

NOWPayments is designed for security and privacy, requiring no KYC and enabling anonymous transactions. It processes payments quickly and efficiently, ensuring your customers have a seamless buying experience.
